label: National public holidays
context: The table lists 11 public holidays that apply across the country: New Year's Day, the day after New Year's Day, Waitangi Day, Good Friday, Easter Monday, Anzac Day, King's Birthday, Matariki, Labour Day, Christmas Day and Boxing Day. Each region also has its own anniversary day.

label: Good Friday, 2027
context: Good Friday varies each year. The date shown is the day it is observed in 2027.

label: Easter Monday, 2027
context: Easter Monday varies each year. The date shown is the day it is observed in 2027.

label: King's Birthday, 2027
context: King's Birthday falls on the first Monday in June.

label: Matariki, 2027
context: Matariki varies each year. The date shown is the day it is observed in 2027.

label: Labour Day, 2027
context: Labour Day falls on the fourth Monday in October.

label: Auckland Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 29 January.

label: Taranaki Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 31 March. The observed day moves to the second Monday in March to avoid Easter.

label: Hawke's Bay Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 1 November. The observed day is the Friday before Labour Day.

label: Wellington Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 22 January.

label: Marlborough Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 1 November. The observed day is the first Monday after Labour Day.

label: Nelson Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 1 February.

label: Canterbury Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 16 December. Northern and Central Canterbury observe Christchurch Show Day instead, the second Friday after the first Tuesday in November. South Canterbury has its own day, shown separately.

label: Canterbury (South) Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 16 December. South Canterbury observes Dominion Day, the fourth Monday in September.

label: Westland Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 1 December. The observed day varies throughout Westland, but Greymouth observes the official day.

label: Otago Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 23 March. Otago has no single day of local observance, so the employee and employer rely on the employment agreement or custom and practice.

label: Southland Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 17 January. Southland normally observes the day on Easter Tuesday.

label: Chatham Islands Anniversary Day, 2027
context: The observed date in 2027. The actual date is 30 November.
